bi/custom-applications/create-custom-app.operation_summary: This endpoint creates a custom application.

request_body.name: description
request_body.description: Description of the custom application. Cannot contain < or > characters.

request_body.name: signatures[].type
request_body.description: Only HOST-based signatures are supported. HOST checks the hostname field.

request_body.name: signatures[].value
request_body.description: The hostname string to match against.

response_schema.name: [].description
response_schema.description: Description of the custom application. Cannot contain < or > characters.

response_schema.name: [].signatures[].type
response_schema.description: Only HOST-based signatures are supported. HOST checks the hostname field.

response_schema.name: [].signatures[].value
response_schema.description: The hostname string to match against.

request_root.title: BICustomApplicationDTO
request_root.description: Only HOST-based custom applications are supported via the Public API. URL-based custom applications are not supported at this time. Limits: - Per custom app: up to 50 HOST signatures. - Must include at least 1 HOST signature. - Name must be unique across all custom apps. - Description is required, max 1024 chars, no < or > allowed. - Signature values must be valid hostnames. - Global limit: 1000 host-based custom apps.

bi/custom-applications/delete-custom-app.operation_summary: Deletes a custom application by its unique identifier (id). If there is any scheduled report associated with the custom app ID then that particular report will also be deleted.

bi/reports/get-all-reports.operation_summary:
List all the reports based on provided details.

**reportType**:
- APPLICATION - For Application Reports
- WORKPLACE - For Workplace Reports
- DATA_EXPLORER - For Data Explorer Reports

**subType** helps to filter only certain types of reports. Default it's optional and pointing to "CustomDataFeed".
- CustomDataFeed - For custom Apps list and download
- ScheduledReports - For scheduled reports list and download
- SaveAndSchedule - For data explorer save and schedule reports list and download

query_params.name: endTime
query_params.description: Report end time as Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch). If not provided or 0, defaults to the current time.

query_params.name: startTime
query_params.description: Report start time as Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch). If not provided or 0, defaults to midnight UTC of the 1st day of previous month.
